notes.title: Bongo Cat, still one of the biggest games on Steam, gets even bigger with multiplayer: You can now have up to 100 cats on your screen at once, all of them happily bapping away as their owners type
notes.content: Back in April we discovered Bongo Cat, a silly idle game about a cat with a hat who smacks your screen when you type. Silly, but also huge: Bongo Cat was one of the biggest games on Steam at the time, holding the number 12 spot on Steam's most played chart. Four months later it's still riding high on the charts, and earlier this week it got even better—because Bongo Cat is now multiplayer... Read more.

notes.title: Meowtiplayer

Just a seamless Steam integration. [/p][p]
Check out this cool trailer!![/p][previewyoutube="U191XLPQAXs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]Fruit Fusion Sets[/b] [/h2][p]When you are in a [b]multiplayer session[/b] with [b]at least one other player[/b], you will receive a pop-up after a while. notes.title: QoL, Bug Fixes and Trading Changes
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋

WHAT A LAUNCH, thanks to everyone playing! I love to read all your messages in the morning <3

Over 150.000 people played the game already, that is INSANE!!!

[b]I now gathered multiple issues and changed a few things:
[/b][list]
[*]Fixes a bug that screen boundaries are ignored and your mouse could move to another screen
[*]Fixes that your game tabs out if you hover over the cat in a fullscreen game
[*]Adds the "Admin Mode" you need to opt-in this will make Bongo Cat start as admin, which solves a lot of issues regarding clicks not getting tracked in several games!
[*]Adds a quit button, yeah i know, long overdue, but why would you quit Bongo Cat :(
[/list]

[b]And now to one of the more controversial changes: i just removed trading between two users (NOT THE MARKET, THIS STILL WORKS). I noticed bot accounts farming thousands of items and by moving the items to one single account and then selling a ton of them in bulk. To prevent this i now removed trading between two users this will make their lifes harder (i hope).[/b]
This doesn't mean that this is permanent but i want to ensure that everybody has a good time, if i can handle the bots then i will try to bring this back <3 Thanks for your understanding!


If you read this: the gaming mode disables all interactions until a chest is ready, i added this so you can focus on your game and still collect the rewards and not accidently clicking on things. Hope this clarifies a few things.

[b]A small list of things i will add soon:[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller support is still WIP, it's way harder than i anticipated so please stay tuned <3
[*] Sounds (but opt-in)
[*] New items
[*] Fixing the annoying red cross, i finally know the reason: the moment Steam detects you as "away" it will mess with the item drops...already talking to them to see if this can be fixed and how :)
[*] And all the bugs that come up
[/list]

[b]And regarding the special demo items (if you are eligable you can still do this for a few more days, then the demo will become unavailable, so be quick!):[/b]
1. Restart Steam
2. Reinstall the demo (the small Download demo button on main store page)
3. Start the Demo
4. Start the full game

Best
Your pigeon gruu gruu <3

notes.title: Bongo Cat is out meow!!!
notes.content:
The full version of the game is finally here! Thanks everyone for testing and playing the demo, i really didn't expect so many people to play it and enjoy what i made <3 [b]Thank you all![/b]

[list]
